title: Simons' inequality (1) and stability give the Hardy-type inequality (3): 2∫_M ψ²|A|²/|x|² ≤ ∫_M |A|²|∇^Mψ|²
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P a subspace with dim A₀ = m + 1, M ⊆ A₀ with 0 ∉ M, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M for every r ∈ ℕ, closure(M) ⊆ M ∪ {0}, tx ∈ M for x ∈ M and t > 0, H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K, and M stationary away from 0; let ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C^∞ on some open O ⊇ M, with ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x, for every x ∈ M; assume trace(P_x∘Dν(x)) = 0 on M, the stability inequality B.1 (∫_M |A|²ζ² dH^m ≤ ∫_M Σ_j(δ_jζ)² dH^m for every ζ locally Lipschitz on M vanishing on M outside a compact subset of M), and (HL) the conclusion of the Lipschitz-approximation lemma for M (verbatim the conclusion of Submission.codim1_hcp_lipschitz_smooth_approx): (i) for every ζ locally Lipschitz on M and every j, x ↦ δ_jζ(x) is a.e. strongly measurable for H^m⌞M; (ii) for every ζ locally Lipschitz on M vanishing on M outside a compact C ⊆ M there are a compact C' ⊆ M and C^∞ compactly supported ζ_k vanishing on M ∖ C', with ζ_k → ζ uniformly on M and ∫⁻_M Σ_j (Dζ_k(x)(P_xe_j) − δ_jζ(x))² dH^m → 0. Throughout: P_y is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M y), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, H^m = μHE[m], |A|²(y) := Σ_j |Dν(y)(P_ye_j)|² (Dν = fderiv ℝ ν), δ_jg(y) := fderivWithin ℝ g M y (P_ye_j). Then for every ψ locally Lipschitz on M vanishing on M outside a compact subset of M: 2∫_M ψ²|A|²/|x|² dH^m ≤ ∫_M |A|²·Σ_j(δ_jψ)² dH^m.
